title: A Decade of International Energy, 2015–2025: Critical Institutions, Path Dependence, and Disasters
content: My column in this journal, titled International Energy (at the editor's suggestion in 2015), now spans a decade. My individual columns have almost always been about economic regulation somewhere in producing and delivering electricity and natural gas as a public service. Being so inescapably connected to the economics of regulation, my column could just as easily have been titled International Regulation.
author: Jeff D. Makholm
